svg.aria-label: System map of Cairn. A client reaches an Nginx gateway, then the FastAPI service, which stores chunks and vectors in PostgreSQL with pgvector and calls the external Gemini API to generate answers. FastAPI exposes metrics to Prometheus, which feeds Grafana dashboards and Alertmanager alerts. Everything except the client and Gemini runs from one docker compose file.
